"""Bump feedsmith's version, roll the changelog, commit and tag. Never pushes."""

from __future__ import annotations

import datetime as dt
import re
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(subprocess.run(["git", "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel"], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.strip())
VERSION_RE = re.compile(r"^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$")


def _replace(path: Path, pattern: str, repl: str) -> None:
    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    new, n = re.subn(pattern, repl, text, count=1, flags=re.M)
    if n != 1:
        sys.exit(f"could not update version in {path}")
    path.write_text(new, encoding="utf-8")


def main(version: str) -> None:
    if not VERSION_RE.match(version):
        sys.exit(f"not a release version: {version}")
    status = subprocess.run(["git", "status", "--porcelain"], capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=ROOT)
    if status.stdout.strip():
        sys.exit("working tree is not clean")

    _replace(ROOT / "pyproject.toml", r'^version = ".*"$', f'version = "{version}"')
    _replace(ROOT / "src/feedsmith/__init__.py", r'^__version__ = ".*"$', f'__version__ = "{version}"')

    changelog = ROOT / "CHANGELOG.md"
    today = dt.date.today().isoformat()
    text = changelog.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    if "## Unreleased" not in text:
        sys.exit("CHANGELOG.md has no Unreleased section")
    changelog.write_text(
        text.replace("## Unreleased", f"## Unreleased\n\n## {version} - {today}", 1), encoding="utf-8"
    )

    subprocess.run(["git", "commit", "-am", f"release: {version}"], cwd=ROOT, check=True)
    subprocess.run(["git", "tag", "-a", f"v{version}", "-m", f"feedsmith {version}"], cwd=ROOT, check=True)
    print(f"tagged v{version}; push with: git push origin main v{version}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) != 2:
        sys.exit("usage: bump_version.py <version>")
    main(sys.argv[1])
